newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - Morrison eyes limited overs return.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - Morrison eyes limited overs return.

text.p: HAMILTON, Feb 3 - Test bowling discard Danny Morrison is looking at a possible comeback to the New Zealand team for the one day cricket series against England, NZPA reported on Monday.
Morrison, who turned 31 today, said that because the two remaining tests against England were being played back to back, he had to concentrate on trying to return for the one day series.
He said the most difficult part of the past few days was having to deal with his exclusion in the wake of the first test escape.
"The hardest thing was that we were on such a high with the innings I played along with Nathan (Astle)," he said.
"But I knew what the call was all about when Ross Dykes (chairman of selectors) phoned me while I was playing club cricket on Saturday."
Morrison said he had a similar feeling when he was dropped for the series against Zimbabwe last summer.
"Then I had to go down and play Shell Trophy matches in order to make a comeback and it feels the same now," he said.
"I have got to get back into rhythm and just start bowling well again.
"I don't know what the selectors want to do but I would like to give myself a chance for the one day series and the tests against Sri Lanka."
